description: The Interactive Hydropower Generation Map is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Erik Schmidt, Megan Johnson (Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)). This interactive map shows the spatial distribution and temporal trends of net generation for hydropower facilities in the U.S., as included in the Existing Hydropower Assets (EHA) Net Generation Plant Database.
